text:
No, you don't need to send the dead plant back. Under the Plant Care Guarantee, you file a claim from "My Orders" with at least two photos (the whole plant and a close-up). This must be within 30 days of delivery, or 90 days for Leafy Plus members. A Plant Care Specialist reviews it within 2 business days.

If the plant arrived dead or badly damaged and it's been less than 48 hours since delivery, report it with photos of the plant and the box. That route gets you a free replacement or a refund. The policy doesn't require returning a DOA plant either.
